PAUL RICE INVESTMENTStaking Dashboard
GETTING STARTED

Your dashboard guide

  1. Choose your network

    Polygon accounts use POL for accounting and payouts. BNB Chain accounts use USDT. The two accounts are independent.

  2. Connect your wallet

    Use a compatible browser wallet. Connecting shares your public address and requests no transfer or signature.

  3. Choose a deposit asset

    Polygon accepts POL or USDT. BNB Chain accepts BNB or USDT. Alternative assets are swapped into the account's currency when deposited.

  4. Track and withdraw rewards

    Rates use the active net deposit after the 2% fee. Current minimum withdrawals are 2 POL or 1 USDT. Contract settings can change.

Deposits and withdrawals require confirmation in your wallet. Account information is read directly from the selected contract.

  :host {
    --local-duration-height: 0s;
    --local-duration: ${({durations:e})=>e.lg};
    --local-transition: ${({easings:e})=>e["ease-out-power-2"]};
  }

  .container {
    display: block;
    overflow: hidden;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    height: var(--local-container-height);
    transition: height var(--local-duration-height) var(--local-transition);
    will-change: height, padding-bottom;
  }

  .container[data-mobile-fullscreen='true'] {
    overflow: scroll;
  }

  .page {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    width: inherit;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background-color: ${({tokens:e})=>e.theme.backgroundPrimary};
    border-bottom-left-radius: var(--local-border-bottom-radius);
    border-bottom-right-radius: var(--local-border-bottom-radius);
    transition: border-bottom-left-radius var(--local-duration) var(--local-transition);
  }

  .page[data-mobile-fullscreen='true'] {
    height: 100%;
  }

  .page-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 100%;
  }

  .footer {
    height: var(--apkt-footer-height);
  }

  div.page[view-direction^='prev-'] .page-content {
    animation:
      slide-left-out var(--local-duration) forwards var(--local-transition),

    animation-delay: 0ms, var(--local-duration, ${({durations:e})=>e.lg});
  }

    from {
      transform: translateX(0px) scale(1);

      filter: blur(0px);

    to {
      transform: translateX(8px) scale(0.99);
      opacity: 0;
      filter: blur(4px);
    }
  }

  @keyframes slide-left-in {
    from {
      transform: translateX(-8px) scale(0.99);
      opacity: 0;
      filter: blur(4px);
    }
    to {
      transform: translateX(0) translateY(0) scale(1);
